name: system-architect
description: Protect module boundaries and keep agent-work governance proportional to risk.

interface.shortDescription: Protect boundaries and remove duplicate governance.
interface.longDescription: Places product changes into independently owned modules, validates file scope, and right-sizes long-horizon, multi-session and multi-machine governance against concrete risks.
